issues.where: the sea east of the pelvis between the two legs
issues.what: the long rusty-red sediment plume streaming out of the pelvis into the ocean and the warm ochre currents around the lower leg are completely missing
issues.fix: restore the red plume trailing eastward from the pelvis basin into the sea between the legs and bring back the warm ochre currents around the lower body

issues.where: the rib and limb mountain ridges in the bottom crop and across the continent
issues.what: the warm sandy-tan and rust-brown rock ridges with bright turquoise coastal shallows in -a are replaced by stark white snow-capped peaks over dark chocolate-brown slopes and muted dark teal water
issues.fix: reduce the heavy white snow caps on the ribs and limbs to warm tan and terracotta rock with snow limited to major peaks, and brighten the turquoise coastal shallows

issues.where: the ocean along the right edge from the upper foot down toward the cyclone
issues.what: the localized pale-gold sun glint in the upper-right corner of -a becomes a broad, flat, muddy tan-grey swath extending down the entire right edge with an abrupt transition into the dark sea
issues.fix: confine the sun glint to a brighter, smoother specular highlight in the upper-right corner and soften its falloff into the dark blue ocean

issues.where: the cyclone in the lower-right corner (top crop)
issues.what: the spiral cloud bands are thin, harsh, fibrous white streaks over sparser dark ocean with a tiny pinched eye instead of the thick, soft, billowy cloud bands and broader eye in -a
issues.fix: soften and thicken the cyclone's spiral cloud bands with fuller cloud cover and subtle shadow depth, and widen the eye slightly to match -a

issues.where: just above and right of the skull between the head and upper shoulder
issues.what: the soft, wispy pale mist plumes curving off the skull and neck in -a are missing, replaced by two small sharp white streaks
issues.fix: replace the two sharp streaks with soft, wispy pale cloud plumes trailing gently back from the upper skull and neck

issues.where: inside the upper ribcage between the third and fourth ribs
issues.what: the bright glowing orange volcanic spot visible in -a is dimmed to a barely visible faint speck
issues.fix: restore the bright orange volcanic glow in the upper ribcage so it reads clearly against the surrounding dark terrain
